descriptions.short: Boise Remodeling Co is a design-build remodeling contractor serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, and the Treasure Valley.
descriptions.long: Boise Remodeling Co is a design-build remodeling contractor serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, and the wider Treasure Valley across Ada and Canyon County. We handle kitchen and bathroom remodels, home additions, accessory dwelling units, basement finishing, and whole-home renovations under one roof, taking each project from design through construction with a single accountable team and a written scope before work begins.
